title: SAGE: A Statistical Acceptance Gate for Self-Evolving Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.36043v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents increasingly self-evolve by editing a persistent skill document that encodes their workflow, tool-use rules, and decision logic. This loop has two steps, an optimizer that proposes a candidate edit and a gate that accepts or rejects it. Prior work has concentrated on the optimizer, while the gate still follows a naive rule that keeps any edit which improves an aggregate validation score. We show that this rule fails in two ways. First, it admits permanent regressions, since an edit can raise the average while breaking items the skill already solves. Second, it is vulnerable to the Optimizer's Curse, since the best observed score on a finite and noisy validation set is upward biased. To solve the above two limitations, we propose a statistical acceptance gate for self-evolving agents (SAGE). Compared with previous work, SAGE has two contributions. translated_title: SAGE：面向自进化智能体的统计接受门控
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体越来越多地通过编辑一份持久化的技能文档来实现自我进化，该文档编码了智能体的工作流程、工具使用规则和决策逻辑。这一自进化循环包含两个步骤：一个优化器负责提出候选编辑方案，一个门控器负责决定接受或拒绝该方案。以往的工作主要集中在优化器上，而门控器仍然遵循一种朴素的规则——只要某次编辑能提升整体验证分数就予以保留。我们证明这一规则在两个方面存在缺陷。首先，它会引入永久性的性能倒退，因为一次编辑可能在提高平均分的同时破坏技能本来已经能够解决的条目。其次，它容易受到“优化者诅咒”的影响，因为在有限且含噪声的验证集上观察到的最佳分数存在向上偏差。为解决上述两个局限，我们提出了一种面向自进化智能体的统计接受门控。与以往工作相比，SAGE有两项贡献：首先，SAGE提出了逐条目的配对比较方法……
tldr: 该论文提出SAGE——一种用于自进化智能体的统计接受门控，通过逐条目的配对比较，解决了传统门控规则会引入永久性性能倒退以及易受“优化者诅咒”影响的两大缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SAGE, a statistical acceptance gate for self-evolving agents that uses per-item paired comparison to address two flaws of naive gates: admitting permanent regressions and being vulnerable to the Optimizer's Curse.
